findings.title: Missing sitemap.xml File
findings.plainEnglishCause: No sitemap.xml file was discovered at /sitemap.xml. Sitemaps help search engine crawlers index all your public URLs efficiently.

fixSteps.instruction: Generate and host a sitemap.xml file at the root of your domain.
fixSteps.codeSnippet:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">
  <url>
    <loc>https://yourdomain.com/</loc>
    <changefreq>daily</changefreq>
    <priority>1.0</priority>
  </url>
</urlset>

fixSteps.instruction: Update or remove the dead href link, or configure a 301 redirect on your server.

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
findings.plainEnglishCause: The server does not enforce HTTPS connections via HSTS. Users communicating over insecure networks could be vulnerable to SSL stripping and man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks.
findings.technicalDetails: Strict-Transport-Security header is absent in response headers.

fixSteps.instruction: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header in Helmet or your web server configuration.
If using Nginx as a reverse proxy, add the header in your server block.
fixSteps.codeSnippet: add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload" always;

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
findings.plainEnglishCause: No Content-Security-Policy header was detected. Without a CSP, the application is more susceptible to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and malicious script injection.

fixSteps.instruction: Configure a restrictive Content Security Policy specifying allowed script, style, and connect origins.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header (Clickjacking Risk)
findings.plainEnglishCause: The page does not set X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors, allowing third-party sites to embed your pages in an iframe and attempt clickjacking attacks.

fixSteps.instruction: Set X-Frame-Options to DENY or SAMEORIGIN.

findings.title: High Latency Under Light Concurrent Load (10 Reqs)
findings.plainEnglishCause: During a light test with 10 concurrent requests, average response latency exceeded 1500ms. This indicates potential thread contention, unindexed database queries, or server resource bottlenecks.

fixSteps.instruction: Profile backend handlers, add database indexes on queried fields, and implement connection pooling.

findings.title: Server Errors Under Light Concurrent Load
findings.plainEnglishCause: The server produced 5xx errors or connection drops when handling 10 simultaneous requests. The backend is struggling with concurrency.
findings.technicalDetails: Failed requests under 10 concurrent requests. Status distribution: {"200":4,"Network_Error":6}

fixSteps.instruction: Check server logs for unhandled rejection errors, database connection pool exhaustion, or memory limits.

findings.title: Slow Time to First Byte (TTFB > 800ms)
findings.plainEnglishCause: The server took over 800ms before sending the first byte of HTML. This is typically caused by un-cached database queries, slow SSR rendering, or distant server regions.

fixSteps.instruction: Implement HTTP edge caching (Cloudflare / Vercel Edge / Fastly) and optimize backend database queries.
fixSteps.codeSnippet:
// Cache-Control header
res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'public, s-maxage=3600, stale-while-revalidate=86400');

findings.title: Poor Largest Contentful Paint (LCP > 4.0s)
findings.plainEnglishCause: The largest visible element (hero image, banner, or heading) took longer than 4.0 seconds to render, signaling significant perceptual slowness.

fixSteps.instruction: Preload critical hero images and optimize image formats using modern AVIF/WebP.
fixSteps.codeSnippet: <link rel="preload" as="image" href="/hero.webp" fetchpriority="high" />

fixSteps.instruction: Ensure your server response time (TTFB) is fast and avoid render-blocking CSS/JavaScript.
